title: Speed dependent descending control of freezing behavior in Drosophila melanogaster
quote: CsChrimson activation of DNp09 neurons was sufficient to trigger freezing in 61.5% (492/800) of trials
mapping_basis: Paper uses Namiki name DNp09, an exact MANC type; kit synonyms also list hemibrain name DNp09 for DNp71 (ambiguous), so DNp09 chosen per Namiki line SS01540 (kit lists SS01540 as AMBIGUOUS DNp09;DNp71).
stimulation: 627 nm red LEDs, 0.025 mW/mm2, 10 repetitions of 2 s on / 20 s off
other_cell_types: weak off-target labeling (unnamed; per FlyLight images)
penetrance: freezing in 61.5% (492/800) of trials; an initial running bout (largely absent in controls) preceded freezing; jumps at light offset
notes: Mixed outcome: running bout then freezing, freezing probability depends on pre-stimulus speed (closed-loop: 85% freezing at low speed). Leg rhythm set unclear because running (walking=yes) and freezing (no) both reported. No leg tracking.
